displayName.ja: 【６月の花嫁】 相州　蛇子

profile.ja: 対魔忍。代々ふうまの家に仕える下忍の家柄で、五車学園の同級生でもある。獣遁の術使いの中でも花形とされる”獣化忍”で、獣の力を体に宿す能力を持つ。彼女の獣化はタイプ”Devilfish”つまりタコ化する。名前は蛇子なのにタコになるというよく分からん女だ……と主人公には言われているが本人曰く『蛇子』は元々曾祖母の名前で、その曾祖母は大蛇に変化する獣化忍だったという。タコ化すると両足がそれぞれ一本の太いタコ足となり、この両足と両手に持った忍者小太刀四本による四刀流戦法を得意としている。身長は自称150センチ。149センチだろうと言われると墨を吐いて怒る。彼女が獣化して放つ墨は五車では有名で、体に付けば魚臭さが三日三晩消えないと恐れられている。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin. Coming from a line of junior ninjas who have served the Fuuma family for generations, she is also a classmate at Gosha Academy. Among beast-transformation users, she is a star "Beast-Transformation Ninja" who can imbue her body with animal power. Her beast form is the "Devilfish" type, meaning she turns into an octopus. Though her name is Hebiko, she becomes an octopus—a confusing fact the protagonist points out; Hebiko explains that the name comes from her great-grandmother, who was a beast-transformation ninja that turned into a great snake. When she octopus-transforms, each leg becomes a single thick tentacle, and she favors a four-blade style using those tentacles and four ninja short swords. She claims to be 150 cm tall; when told she's probably 149 cm, she spits ink in anger. The ink she releases in her beast form is infamous at Gosha, feared for leaving a fishy stench on anyone's body for three days and nights.

text.ja: いつかこの日が来たらいいなって、ずっと思ってた。ねえ……蛇子の事、幸せにしてくれる？　してくれなくちゃ、泣いちゃうぞ☆
text.en: I've always hoped that day would come someday. Hey… will you make Hebiko happy? If you don't, I'll end up crying☆

text.ja: あなたぁ、新婚旅行はどこがいいかしら？　……分かってるって、任務のための演技よ、演技……ほら、続けて？　あ・な・た♪
text.en: You… where should we go for a honeymoon? …I know, it's just acting for the mission, acting… come on, continue? A-na-ta♪

text.ja: 出会う前より出会ってからの時間が長くなったの、いつからかな。……それよりもずっとずーーっと長く、一緒にいようね♪
text.en: I feel like the time we've spent together has gotten longer than the time before we met… I wonder when that started. …Even longer than that—let's stay together forever ♪

text.ja: 他の人からのお願いだったらいくら任務のためでも絶対着ないわよ。行き遅れるって言うし……え？　ふふふ、なぜでしょー？
text.en: If it's a request from someone else, even for a mission I'd never wear it. They'd say I'd be late… huh? Hehe, why do you think?

text.ja: 蛇子のこの姿、目に焼き付けておいてね。もし望むなら……任務が終わった後でも、もう一度だけ着てあげてもいいよ
text.en: Make sure you imprint this look of mine into your eyes. If you want… even after the mission's over, I could let you see me in it one more time.

text.ja: ねぇねぇ、夫婦なのにキスの一つもしないのって、怪しまれないかな？　……う……や、やっぱり今のなし！
text.en: Hey, hey, we're married and we don't even share a single kiss—won't that look suspicious? …Ugh… no, never mind, scratch that!

text.ja: もーそんな風に言って。このドレスがあるから墨吐けないと思ってるでしょ！　吐くわよ！　任務が終わったら、容赦なく吐くわ！
text.en: Geez, saying it like that. You think I can't spit ink because I'm wearing this dress, don't you? I will! After the mission's over, I'll spit it without holding back!

text.ja: もう少しで式だよね……はあぁ、緊張してきた……え、あ、うん、そう！　大切な任務だからね、緊張しちゃうの！
text.en: The ceremony's almost here… *sigh* I'm getting nervous… yeah, right! It's an important mission, so it's natural to be nervous!

text.ja: んっ、は……演技、これも演技だから、ね？　大丈夫、余計な事は何も考えずに、任務に没頭しちゃおう？　……あっ、はぁぁ……
text.en: Hmm… it's all acting, right? Don't worry, just don't think about anything unnecessary and throw yourself into the mission. …Ah, *breathes*

text.ja: ん、んんっ！　っはぁ、はぁ……ねえ、式の途中でできちゃっても、できちゃった婚っていうのかな？
text.en: Mmm, mmm! *pant* Hey, if we… end up… during the ceremony, does that count as a shotgun wedding?

text.ja: 本当にいいの？　だって蛇子あなた以外の人に……あぁぁっ……う、うん、無茶苦茶にして……あなたの事魂に刻み込んで上書きしてぇ
text.en: Are you sure that's okay? Because with anyone other than you… ahh… yeah, I'll mess them up completely… and imprint you onto my soul, overwriting everything!
